extensions.question: Question: do two independent confirmers agree beyond chance on the same subsample, and what is Cohen's kappa? While kappa is below the declared threshold, a single-confirmer CONFIRMED is automatically DEMOTED to PARTIAL rather than being carried as a pass.

upstream_stand_in.reason: dependency receipts absent; frame frozen rather than blocked

negative_controls.description: Permuting one rater's labels must drop kappa toward 0; forced agreement must stay at kappa=1.
A single-confirmer CONFIRMED at sub-threshold kappa must become PARTIAL.

negative_controls.bad_state_output: would be PARTIAL if confirmer_count were 1
negative_controls.description: Demotion must NOT fire when two independent confirmers already agree, even below the kappa threshold.

demotion_rule.predicate: while kappa < threshold, a record with confirmer_count==1 and verdict==CONFIRMED is rewritten to PARTIAL; the rewrite does not fire when two independent confirmers (distinct vendors) already agree

observations.method: apply_demotion two distinct vendors over frozen pairs
observations.name: dual-independent-demotions-on-frame

threshold_preregistration.citation: Landis JR, Koch GG (1977). The measurement of observer agreement for categorical data. Biometrics 33:159-174. The 0.60 floor is the lower bound of their 'substantial' band. Declared as the CNF-0134 demotion floor before any kappa is computed on this unit.

residual_unknowns.claim: Live CNF-0133 calibration corpus and CNF-0137 sampling-frame receipts are absent; dual-vendor verdicts are synthetic.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Re-derive kappa on the shared CNF-0137 subsample once both vendor confirmation records and the CNF-0133 corpus exist.

retry.policy: No retry. A statistical result that is re-drawn until it looks acceptable is p-hacking; if the computation errors, fix the computation and re-derive from the frozen frame.

reviewer.notes: Recomputed unweighted Cohen's kappa from the published raw_table.counts only; did not re-draw the subsample.

tests.name: Two confirmers forced to agree yield kappa near 1
Randomly permuted verdicts yield kappa near 0
